response.description: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are now available in public preview. Workloads sharing a task hub can have different throughput requirements and downstream service limits. Create named queues within a task hub and configure a shared actions-per-second dispatch rate for orchestration and activity work.Select a queue by setting the DTS_TaskQueue tag to the queue’s name when starting a workflow. Teams can pace workloads and assign separate throughput budgets without changing function names. The rate controls work-item dispatch, not execution concurrency.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
